brief: public boolean isSpecializationOf(MediaType a, MediaType b){}
method_comment: * Checks whether the given media type a is a specialization of a more * generic type b. Both types should be already normalised. * * @param a media type, normalised * @param b suspected supertype, normalised * @return true if b is a supertype of a, * false otherwise * @since Apache Tika 0.8
